status: exploratory two-batch panel; no inference or predictive edge claimed

excluded_batches.ndx-2023-12: initial list revised after the Seagen acquisition; requires security-specific revision clocks

interpretation: Recent complete batches show a positive next-open announcement separation but no addition pressure continuation into the implementation close.
Implementation-session whole-day volume is very large for both sides and larger for additions.
Additions underperform deletions over the next one and five sessions in both complete batches.
The same five-session sign appears in the incomplete 2022 sensitivity, but that batch is excluded from the panel.
Longer-horizon addition outperformance is dominated by prior-winner selection and high dispersion, so it is not evidence of index causality.
limitations: Only two complete batches and eighteen securities.
Security-weighted means do not provide batch-clustered inference.
No candidate controls, factor matching, flow estimates, auction data, or transaction costs.
The five-session reversal pattern is a hypothesis generator, not a validated model.
